entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your full name and order number, please?

Thank you, Alex. Let me pull that up... I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. So, to get started, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It doesn't matter. I just don't want it.
I understand, but the reason helps me find the right solution for you. For example, if it's a technical issue, I'd connect you with our support team—

(Sighs) Fine. It was a gift. I had a medical emergency right after I got it and ended up in the hospital. I needed unexpected surgery, which was a whole ordeal. My brother's military deployment was almost cancelled over it. I just got home and I don't need this.
Oh my, I am so sorry to hear you went through all that. I hope you're recovering well. Let me just check the policy on that for you... Okay, I see the delivery date here.
According to our policy, you have 90 days from the date of delivery for a return. You are well within that window, so this is no problem at all. I can process that for you immediately.

Alright, I've just initiated the return. You will receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next 10 minutes. And Alex, I see here you're one of our VIP members. For all the trouble you've been through, I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account for a future purchase.
Whatever. So I just ship it back?
Yes, that's correct. Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original method of payment. Can I help you with anything else today?
Okay. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a much better day.
